approval_ref: The active goal requires an advanced-model Reference implementation, and the first controlled live question showed that the forced experimental DeepSeek vision route could fail the structured QA V3 contract before a result was saved.
notes: Preserve the existing DeepSeek vision route, but make selected-page image input an explicit saved choice instead of forcing it.
When disabled, keep Reference QA on deepseek-v4-flash text input and freeze that capability in new evaluation tasks.
Do not change existing frozen evaluations, delete the settled failed call, automatically fall back or retry.
Keep Gemini and Mock behavior unchanged, custom image capability unchanged, and API keys write-only.
Full validation passed: 1,495 Python tests, 24 localization tests, 11 deployment tests, 147 synchronized requirements, 21 schemas and a 601-file bundle manifest.
title: Make DeepSeek Reference image input explicit
objective: Let a saved DeepSeek profile explicitly choose text-only or selected-page image input for future Reference evaluations without deleting multimodal support, mutating frozen tasks or adding automatic fallback or retry.
